messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the PM: recurrence of partial streaming responses + user-visible timeouts in yesterday's 07:45-09:10 UTC window. Pattern looks different from previous GH events  we see bursts of small chunks then a hard close. Want owners + minimal-risk mitigations.

tom: Seen it in traces. It looks like the runtime sometimes delays emitting first chunk once token-gen stalls for > 15s; proxy treats silence as idle and terminates.

priya: Example log from edge: 
```
2026-04-10T07:52:12Z proxy=envoy event=RST_STREAM reason=stream_idle_duration request_id=cc7a
2026-04-10T07:52:12Z svc=inference request_id=cc7a model=red-2b duration=19.8s emitted_chunks=1
```
Feels like a micro-chunk + then idle before more tokens, rather than a full abort.

ben: Hypotheses: (1) no keepalive during generation, (2) runtime backpressure holds chunks until token threshold, (3) proxy's idle detection too aggressive.

sylvia: Ops notes: proxy idle window currently 20s globally. Rolling that to 45s likely reduces impact but increases connection resource time. Need canary and rollback plan.

maria: Draft remediation plan (short/medium):
- M1: Canary: increase proxy idle timeout 20s -> 45s on low-traffic region (EU-west)  owner: sylvia/ops  due: 2026-04-12
- M2: Runtime micro-chunk emitter: force an initial small chunk within 3s of request start, then continue normal batching  owner: tom  due: 2026-04-15
- M3: Add app-level keepalive (HTTP/2 PING or zero-length frame) configurable per-route  owner: priya  due: 2026-04-18
- M4: SDK: resilient resume + increased jitter + resume metric `stream.resume_success`  owner: ben  due: 2026-04-22
- M5: Observability: new metrics `stream.partial_chunk_rate`, `stream.chunk_interval_ms` + dashboard tile and pager rules  owner: maria  due: 2026-04-14
- M6: Runbook update + customer comms template  owner: sylvia  due: 2026-04-13

priya: For M3 I recommend implementing both HTTP/2 PING and a fallback micro-chunk flush in runtime. We'll gate the PING behind a feature flag.

tom: For M2, micro-chunk emitter prototype: flush a 1-3 token NOP chunk within 2s of generation start; improves perceived liveness. Will test in staging.

ben: SDK plan: add resume cursor, verify idempotence on server side. Also include network-harness test for reconnect + resume.

sylvia: Ops can run EU-west canary 2026-04-12 01:00-02:00 UTC. I'll add a narrow blast radius and automated rollback steps (INF-5500).

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5500 "partial-chunk patterns - timeout canary + runbook" assigned to ops-oncall. Link: https://tickets/INF-5500

maria: Can everyone update the shared checklist (link below) with status tags: todo / in-progress / blocked / done. I'll host weekly syncs until the metric stabilizes. First sync: 2026-04-13 10:00 UTC. Doc: https://docs.google.com/drive/streaming-partial-checklist

priya: Note: we'll add a short A/B test to ensure micro-chunking doesn't regress throughput for high-qps routes. Flagging potential perf cost.

tom: Will measure request CPU and latency overhead in staging. If overhead > 3% we'll look for binary emit optimizations.

ben: Also adding `stream.resume_latency_ms` metric so we can detect failed resumes quickly.

maria: Product impact: reported ~7% drop in chat completion for affected customers. We should prepare a short customer-facing blurb if canary changes user-visible behavior.

priya: I'll draft a templated blurb for Dedicated customers (opt-in canary) and hosted customers note.

sylvia: Ops: adding canary watchlist metrics: partial_chunk_rate, stream.resume_success, 5xx rate, and conn_count. Rollback if partial_chunk_rate increases or resume_success drops.

ops-bot: Canary window scheduled and added to INF-5500. Rollback conditions: partial_chunk_rate +20% or resume_success -10% over baseline in 10min window.

maria: Summary: M1/M5/M6 asap (48-72h), M2/M3 next sprint, M4 following SDK cycle. Weekly sync 2026-04-13. Please post blockers here. Closing thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
